scope: Catalog physical values that contradict object-specific literature: Gaia DR3 FLAME ages and masses whose own GSP-Phot metallicity breaks FLAME's solar-metallicity assumption, uncalibrated GSP-Phot metallicities of hot stars, and isolated outlier selections from the frozen SIMBAD mesFe_h pool. Found by comparing Info articles with spec-sheet values and catalog values with the frozen literature pool. This is a reviewed candidate set, not a full catalog audit.
policy: Exact SIMBAD/HIP/HD and stable IDs only. Adopt a published value only after checking it in the primary source; otherwise withhold the contradicted model value without inventing a replacement. Preserve membership, spectra, coordinates, motion and unrelated physical fields. Original values remain in this ledger and in catalog provenance.

age_gyr.caveat: Moving-group age with its published 1-sigma uncertainty.

age_gyr.method: Peak of the Yonsei-Yale isochrone probability distribution fitted to the paper's differential UVES Teff, log g and [Fe/H] (sections 2.4-2.5).

age_gyr.method: Peak of the Yonsei-Yale isochrone probability distribution fitted to the paper's differential UVES Teff, log g and [Fe/H] (sections 2.4-2.5).
age_gyr.caveat: The tabulated bounds are a 95 percent interval (4.62-7.05 Gyr), not a 1-sigma error.
